# Copilot Instructions for `janice`

This is a fork of an open-source JSON viewer written in Go.

## Guidelines

- Follow idiomatic Go code style (gofmt, golint).
- Keep code modular and readable.
- Add or update documentation and comments as needed.
- Write concise, effective tests for new features or bugfixes (see `/tests`).

## Copilot Usage

- Use Copilot for boilerplate, helpers, test scaffolding, and refactoring.
- Review all suggestions for correctness and style.
- Don’t commit secrets or credentials.

For major changes, prefer small pull requests with clear commit messages.

Happy hacking!
